title: events on a timeline
seam: the time axis: data-axis (a horizontal line, earlier on the left)
each event: a marker on the axis with data-event="<key>" and data-year="<year>", centred at its year's x (x linear in the year); its card (name and year, the tap target) with data-card="<key>"
brief: KIND: explorable. Events on a timeline.

AXIS: a horizontal time line with earlier years on the left; each event of Studio.params.events (in any order) is a marker exactly at its year's position (x linear in the year between the first and last year, with a margin) and a card with its name and year joined to the marker by a short line; cards never overlap (stagger above and below the line).
QUESTION: ask; the child taps an event card -> Studio.answer("<key>"); feedback from Studio.onVerdict; on correct Studio.done() and the done text.
All events look the same before the answer.
antiPatterns: events spaced evenly instead of by year
